FoodRats is a closed space for small crews to share their meals. These guidelines keep it a place everyone wants to be. They apply to everything you post — photos, dish names, descriptions, comments, and reactions. Breaking them can get your content removed and your account suspended.
Treat your crew the way you\'d want to be treated. Share food, celebrate each other, and keep it friendly. Disagreement is fine; cruelty is not.

Do not post content that is, or that promotes:

• Harassment, bullying, or threats against any person
• Hate speech or attacks based on race, ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, disability, or any protected characteristic
• Sexual or sexually explicit material
• Violence, gore, or content that glorifies harm
• Anything illegal, or that infringes someone else's rights

FoodRats screens free text for objectionable language as you type, but the rules above apply to everything you share, including photos.

If you see content or behaviour that breaks these guidelines, report it. Every meal, comment, and profile has a report option. Reports are confidential — the person you report is not told who reported them.
You can block any user. Once blocked, their meals, comments, and reactions disappear from your feed, and they can no longer interact with you. You can manage blocked users from your Profile.

We review reports and remove violating content within 24 hours. Content that is reported by several people is hidden automatically pending review. Repeat offenders are removed from FoodRats. We act on objectionable content and abusive users at our sole discretion.
Questions, or need to reach a human? Email hello@chsumiapps.com or visit https://foodrats-de4ec.web.app.
